findings.claim: The roadmap puts the first real Epoch 1 content pack (the first office, quiet claim, behavior) at position 11 of 27, after AI, dialogue, ONNX, orbital mechanics and epoch transition, so the core fantasy (covert influence through an NPC's mind, with a consequence) cannot be tested by anything playable until nearly the end; 06 utility AI is built against a world with 0 behaviors and 0 offices.

evidence.quote: 11. 11-epoch-1-world-population-and-content-pack — Populate Epoch 1 (Feudal) with its full cast of on-stage & off-stage entities
6. 06-utility-ai-rivals-and-wider-world  — Hysteresis Utility AI, Inertia Pillars & Leverage Chains, Rival Alien Operatives

findings.bites_when: Change 06 is proposed: utility AI, inertia pillars and rivals are specced and evaluated on synthetic fixtures with no authored character desires, so legibility of intrigue (the riskiest assumption) is evaluated on test data, not on something a human watches.
findings.disconfirm: Looked for an earlier content or vertical-slice change in config.yaml 120-148 and DESIGN_NOTES; the proving slice (yard/chambers, 2 characters) is the only content and has no desires, offices or choices (S0). 05f evals do give fixture-based testing, but that tests non-thrashing, not fun.
findings.recommendation: Insert a thin 'Slice 0' change right after 05e: one office, one pretext, one NPC with 2 drives, one conversation-less choice (Space on a prop or person) that dispatches one WorldEffect with a visible consequence 2 minutes later. Playtest it before 06.
findings.ignore_cost: Utility AI, regard graph, ONNX parser and dialogue are all designed around a loop nobody has felt; any wrong guess is found at position 11 and rework fans out across 06-10.

findings.claim: The riskiest assumptions are tested last or never: (a) covert steering via NPC cognition is readable/fun first tested at 11 (or at best 06+07b with no content); (b) anti-slop authored writing first tested at 07e, a fixture/banned-lemma check, not a human reading; (c) free-text NLP at 08 after the choice-menu grammar already exists, with no earlier evidence it is needed; (d) 50-100h pacing is encoded (4 clocks, curve envelopes, 5-stage gates) at 05b before one minute of play exists.

evidence.quote: 8. 08-local-onnx-hybrid-intent           — Local MiniLM-L6-v2 setup script, 3-stage lexical + Web Worker ONNX free-text parser
7e. 07e-voice-register-evals             — Registers banned-lemma, cadence, and clause-omission fixtures on the 05f runner.

findings.bites_when: Now, when choosing what to propose after 05c; each of these is a multi-change investment sitting on an unvalidated bet.
findings.disconfirm: Checked whether any change is labelled prototype/playtest: grep for playtest/prototype/vertical slice in DESIGN_NOTES.md and config.yaml found none. The eval runner (05f) is the only validation mechanism and measures structural properties.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit validation column to the roadmap: for each risky bet, name the cheapest playable or readable test and the change at which it happens. Move the writing-quality check earlier (hand-write 20 lines for one NPC and read them aloud) and make ONNX conditional on the menu grammar proving insufficient.
findings.ignore_cost: Months of infrastructure on 4 clocks, ONNX worker and voice evals may be built for features the first playtest says to cut.

findings.claim: Shipped schemas hardcode design numbers and enums no gameplay has validated: 3 illicit instrument types, 3 pressure stocks, 5 inertia pillars, 4 discovery layers, 3 orbital phases, 3 spoof modes; roughly 17 reducer cases and 11 registry kinds exist with zero dispatchers or content (S0). Each is cheap to change today and costs more with every consumer added by 06/09/10.
findings.bites_when: 06 (inertia pillars, leverage chains) and 09 (orbital) start consuming these enums; the first playtest likely reveals a wrong number of stocks or that pillars should be continuous values, forcing migration of schemas, reducer, legacy export, tests and docs.
findings.disconfirm: Enums are cheap to edit while there are no consumers; the registry is generic so adding a kind is easy. But removal/reshaping is what the 6-8 doc layers (AGENTS.md of 6 sections, DESIGN_NOTES) make sticky; and AGENTS.md states the numbers as facts ('3 societal pressure stocks and 4 discovery layers').
findings.recommendation: Mark all of these as provisional in code and AGENTS.md, and do not add any consumer (06, 09) until the vertical slice has used at least the ones it needs. Consider freezing unused reducer cases behind a 'draft' directory.
findings.ignore_cost: Every later change adds callers to an unvalidated vocabulary, turning a design guess into a migration.

findings.claim: Rework is already queued against the shipped registry: 8 *Tick/ticks fields in EpochBlueprints (stipendPerTick, orbitalOffsetTicks, baseTransitTicks, fuseTicks, zenith/horizon/occludedDurationTicks, burnCostPerTick) are scheduled to be rebased onto Watches in 05b, within days of being written; the change that wrote them (03) is archived.

evidence.quote: - **The 4-Clock Simulation Hierarchy (Rebasing Change 03 `*Tick` Fields onto Campaign Watches)**:

findings.bites_when: 05b is applied: schemas, reducer cases (advance_orbital_pass, insert_illicit_instrument), legacy state and their tests all change units; a Tick-to-Watch semantic change (60Hz frame vs player-spent time) is not a rename.
findings.disconfirm: grep count of 'Tick' in EpochBlueprints.ts gives 8 matching lines; DESIGN_NOTES line 97 shows the pacing problem (an Epoch burning in 15 minutes) was only found after change 03 shipped, so it is real rework, not planned rename.
findings.recommendation: Treat this as the lesson: the time model was designed after the schemas that depend on it. Settle the clock model (a one-page decision, not a whole change) before writing any further time-bearing schema.
findings.ignore_cost: The same pattern repeats for every schema written ahead of the system that gives it units.

findings.claim: Several built subsystems have no caller and will be contradicted or reshaped by later design: the cognitive scheduler pulses over zero behaviors; legacy export/save slots are never called by the app and the legacy ledger precedes any Epoch end (10); the in-browser telemetry cannot satisfy the 'must log to ./logs' rule; and the 05c click-to-waypoint input is replaced by 05d WASD.

evidence.quote: - Watch spending, storylet injection, and arbitrary-ground click-to-move.
5d. 05d-direct-floor-locomotion — Camera-relative WASD on the current floor for a direct-mode body

findings.bites_when: 05d/05e land: click-waypoint verbs, waypoint HUD buttons and the floor-raycast router get demoted to dev-only, and the 0-byte logs/ pipeline plus 'every event MUST be logged' keep misleading debugging.
findings.disconfirm: The click shell is explicitly a 'proving slice' and router is designed for appending bindings, so reuse is partial; the infrastructure logger works from CLI. Waypoint requests remain valid for NPC bodies, so not all is wasted.
findings.recommendation: Label the click/waypoint HUD as dev tooling in 05c docs, and either wire the browser to /api/telemetry or amend the 'must log' rule to match reality.
findings.ignore_cost: Docs and code disagree on what is authoritative and early dead code grows more tests that will be rewritten.

findings.claim: Epoch-agnostic generality has a concrete present cost: the registry/schema layer (EpochModuleRegistry 796 lines, EpochBlueprints 255, reducer 494, legacy 349 = 1,894 lines) is 17% of all src LOC while content is 3 registered entries; and no schema was shaped by a concrete use. The Epoch-1 'exemplar' table already maps *Court Physician* etc. to abstractions, yet the abstractions were coded first.

evidence.quote: - Every mechanic in Epoch 1 / Era 1 (*Highglass Hold*) is built on an **epoch-agnostic domain abstraction** with an explicit `lineageId`

findings.bites_when: Epoch 2 is authored (far away); until then the generality can't be falsified, and every design change in Epoch 1 must be re-expressed through lineageId/legacy abstractions first (the docs mandate this).
findings.disconfirm: Looked for evidence that generality saved work: found none yet because no second epoch exists. Evidence of cost: pacing/Tick rework (S1B-04) came from epoch-agnostic schemas written before the pacing model; a single concrete office would have exposed it. Total 2,205 includes WorldState.ts so 17% is approximate.
findings.recommendation: Write Epoch 1 concretely first with plain data (one office, one thread) and extract the abstraction at the second use (rule of three). Keep lineageId as the only forward-compat hook.
findings.ignore_cost: Abstractions get shaped by guesses about epochs 2-7, not by the one epoch that must be fun.

findings.claim: By roadmap order, the first decision-with-consequence appears at 07b/07c (spend pretext/fund in a conversation), after 05d,05e,05a,05b,05f,06,06a,06c,06b,07 are built, and even then needs the content from 11; an earlier cheap slice using only 05e's Space-use and the existing reducer (e.g. Space on a prop applies a WorldEffect that changes an NPC's drive and is visible in behavior) is not scheduled.

evidence.quote: 7c. 07c-fund-spending-choices            — A conversation choice row may spend a fund and dispatch that row's effect. Depends on 07 [planned — revisable]

findings.bites_when: After 05e ships: the team has WASD, menus and reducer but chooses 05a audio, 05b clocks, 05f evals ahead of a decision loop.
findings.disconfirm: 05e adds a menu stack and 05d an arrival hold with an ambient line; these are interactions but carry no stakes. Roadmap says order is revisable, so reorder is cheap.
findings.recommendation: Reorder: 05d, 05e, then a 'first consequence' change before 05a/05b. Defer 05a audio and 05b pacing until a loop exists to pace.
findings.ignore_cost: 05a/05b/05f absorb weeks without telling you if the game is worth finishing.

keep.claim: The 05f eval runner and FAST_EVAL pacing give a deterministic headless way to test AI legibility cheaply; protect it, but do not mistake it for a fun test.

evidence.quote: - **The loop**: `npm run eval:ai` loads every registered case, rolls it with a fixed seed under `FAST_EVAL_PACING_CONFIG`, and reports pass or fail.

keep.claim: Roadmap is explicitly revisable and was already split when scope changed (05a-f, 07a-e), so reordering is cheap and in-pattern.

unconsidered_routes.title: One-room paper-prototype slice (Slice 0)
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Before 05a/05b/06, build one room, one NPC with two drives, one office pretext and three Space-actions, with one delayed visible consequence, played for 20 minutes with a friend. Use hand-written text and the existing reducer; no audio, clocks or AI.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Thief/Dishonored-style immersive sim greybox; 'Prototype the fantasy first' (Tarn Adams' Dwarf Fortress started as a single-fortress loop)
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Defers 05a, 05b, 06a, 06c, 08 until the slice proves the loop; changes 06 from 'build utility AI' to 'extend what the slice showed was readable'.

unconsidered_routes.title: Reverse the schema-first order: content-first, extract later
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Delete or quarantine registry kinds with no content (rivals, threads, channels, emergencies, orbital) behind a 'draft' folder. Author Epoch 1 entries as plain typed data, and promote an abstraction into the registry only when a second entry needs it.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Rule of three; Rimworld's defs grew out of concrete content, not before it
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Shrinks ~800-line registry to what content uses and removes 8 *Tick fields before 05b has to rebase them.

unconsidered_routes.title: Ship the Ship Mind as a text-only advisor loop first
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Test the writing and the advisory-duel idea with a plain text page: the Mind and Drone give two conflicting briefings on a hand-authored scenario, the player picks. This validates voice/anti-slop and the ethical poles with no engine work.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Disco Elysium skill voices; Papers Please decision-only loop
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Moves 07/07d/07e validation ahead of ONNX (08) and 06's AI; may make 08 unnecessary.
